segments.text: Juggling AI accounts? Not anymore. Meet Quo, your command center for all things AI coding. Whether it's Clawude, Gemini, or OpenAI, Quotio unifies them into one
sleek native Mac OS menu bar app. No more switching tabs. Track quotas, monitor usage, and manage your AI tools in real time. Watch your request traffic
and success rates live on a customizable dashboard and get notifications when things are running
